scope: Independent second review ONLY of exact submitted28:1 and34:1 candidates. No prior review opinions were read before this result was saved. No approval of remaining units or either chapter.

reviews.reason: Exact candidate source matches the chapterXXVIII opening on printed66/PDF104 and continuation on printed68/PDF106 through the clause preceding verse2, including stars before the two opening forms and the solitary/desert clause. The printed words for east, middle, mountain, wilderness, saw, desert and alone support this English. Printed68 note4 explicitly identifies the wilderness term as an Aramaic transliteration, supporting the anchored note. The trailing comma reflects continuation into verse2 rather than loss of text. Acceptance is only for the submitted selected-Charles candidate, not the baseline oracle-derived source or a whole chapter.

The cross-page source recovery itself is supported: printed74/PDF112 has the opening, north and ends wording and main form ምክረ; printed75/PDF113 supplies ወስብሐ and the complete extremities-of-the-whole-earth ending before verse2. Printed74 note47 does give መንክረ as a variant. However the submitted English wonder requires a lexical/source decision between difficult main ምክረ (normally counsel) and variant መንክረ (wonder). The note calls the rendering deliberately literal but does not establish that wonder is literal for the printed main form, or explicitly select the variant for that translation. This reviewer cannot certify that lexical equivalence from the submitted primary scans. Hold the exact bytes until the main-form meaning is independently established or the reliance on a selected variant is explicitly reviewed and disclosed. No plausible lexical rewrite is approved here.
